question: Who are the top customers by total payments?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which customers have spent the least?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) ASC LIMIT 10

question: What are the most profitable film categories?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 10

question: What are the least profitable film categories?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) ASC LIMIT 10

question: Which countries have the most customers?
sql: SELECT co.country FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total payments?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the three least profitable film categories?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which 4 countries have the most customers?
sql: SELECT co.country FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 4

question: Which film is the longest?
sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE length = (SELECT max(length) FROM film)

question: Which film is the shortest?
sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE length = (SELECT min(length) FROM film)

question: Which film has the highest replacement cost?
sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE replacement_cost = (SELECT max(replacement_cost) FROM film)

question: Which customer has rented the most films?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which actor has appeared in the fewest films?
sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1

question: What is the highest replacement cost?
Who is the top-spending customer in each store?
sql: SELECT store_id, first_name, last_name FROM (SELECT c.store_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY c.store_id ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC) AS rk FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.store_id, c.first_name, c.last_name) ranked WHERE rk = 1

question: List all film categories ranked by number of films.
sql: SELECT c.name FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC

question: Which categories have more than 60 films?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING count(*) > 60
